# Demo document pack

Test fixtures for ClearCondo's extraction pipeline and prompt design.

- `m3-sample-reserve-fund-study.pdf` — a real, publicly posted sample reserve
  fund study from M3 Consulting (Alberta). Used to sanity-check extraction
  against a genuine third-party document.
- `demo-01` … `demo-04` — synthetic documents for the fictional
  "North Hill Terrace" (Condominium Corporation No. 0614321), generated by
  `generate_demo_docs.py`. They contain six baked-in red flags that the
  analysis prompt must catch (see the script header):
  1. $8,500/unit special assessment (parkade membrane)
  2. Reserve fund at 61% of recommended
  3. Unfunded $1.15M envelope remediation
  4. Window-leak litigation in mediation
  5. $100,000 insurance deductible after hail claim
  6. Proposed 15% rental cap + repeat nuisance complaints (unit 1204)

All synthetic pages are watermarked "SAMPLE DOCUMENT — DEMO DATA ONLY".
Regenerate with: `python3 generate_demo_docs.py` (needs `reportlab`).
